title_sq: Apartament 3+1 për Shitje pranë tregut Elektrik!
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje godine 3 kateshe e ndetuar ne vitin 2005. Planimetria e prones eshte shume e rregullt dhe e organizuar nga nje sallon ndenje, tre dhoma gjumi, dy tualet me dritare si dhe dy ballkone. . Orientimi eshte nga Jugu dhe ka ndricimi natyral gjate gjithe dites. Ne cmimin e prones eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi i jashtem.
Zona eshte shume e qete dhe te ofron te gjitha facilitetet.
title_en: 3+1 apartment for sale near the Electric market!
description_en: The apartment is located on the third floor of a 3-story building built in 2005. The layout of the property is very regular and organized by a living room, three bedrooms, two bathrooms with windows and two balconies. . The orientation is from the South and there is natural lighting throughout the day. An outdoor parking space is included in the price of the property. The area is very quiet and offers all facilities.
